title: Euler-Lagrange Equation
description: The equation partial L / partial q_i - d/dt(partial L / partial qdot_i) = 0 characterizing sufficiently smooth stationary paths of a first-order action under fixed-endpoint variations.
aliases: Lagrange's equations of the second kind

relations.note: The equation is obtained by setting the first variation to zero.
Arbitrariness of interior variations yields the pointwise equation.
Mechanical equations of motion follow from the chosen Lagrangian.
